messages.learner: I am stuck finding the units of area under velocity versus time. Give me one hint that lets me do the calculation for a constant 4 m/s for 3 seconds.

messages.tutor: For constant velocity, the area is a rectangle: velocity × time. Multiply \(4\,\text{m/s}\) by \(3\,\text{s}\)—what units remain when the seconds cancel?

messages.learner: I still don't know what multiplying by seconds does. Please show me the full calculation and stop.
